skeptic.key_risk: A sustained risk-on melt-up that drives momentum regardless of internal breadth, pushing these overextended sectors further before mean reversion kicks in.

base_rate.stance: Flow lens is display-only (rank-IC ~0) and regime snapshot is coincident; base rates imply all sector and VIX calls are noise with no forward edge.
base_rate.key_risk: A sudden VIX spike that breaks the calm base rate, but the lens has no predictive edge to anticipate it.

The Industrials-Materials pair (corr 0.82) shows a supply-chain spread with Industrials likely anchoring the move, given its broader membership and higher relative strength.
